# BNL Plus

> BNL Plus is an online fitness and general nutrition coaching brand (a Bluffs Nutrition Lounge brand) founded by coach Elijah Robles in Scottsbluff, Nebraska. Its flagship program, Body Rebuild, is a 16-week online strength and nutrition system for busy adults 35+ who have been inactive or inconsistent and want to rebuild strength, lose fat, and return to consistent training. Coaching is available across the United States; local Private sessions are available in the Scottsbluff, Nebraska area by appointment.

Key facts:
- Program: Body Rebuild — 16 weeks, three required strength workouts per week plus one optional Rebuild Accelerator session.
- Training tracks: Foundation, Build, and Performance — each available for Home or Gym.
- Nutrition: practical structure (protein targets, portions, habits, food logging when appropriate); no rigid meal plans and no medical nutrition therapy.
- Tiers: Body Rebuild Essentials ($149/month × 4, $596 total, self-directed), Body Rebuild Coaching ($229/month × 4, $916 total, weekly feedback and group accountability, max 10 per cohort — recommended for most clients), Body Rebuild Private ($499/month × 4, $1,996 total, weekly 1:1 support, max 5 active clients).
- Enrollment path: free Restart Assessment → application → review → Fit Call (Coaching/Private) → payment. No purchase before application approval.
- Scope: fitness and general nutrition coaching only — not medical care, injury diagnosis, rehabilitation, physical therapy, medication management, or medical nutrition therapy.

- [Restart Assessment](https://www.bnlch.com/restart-assessment): Free 5-minute assessment returning restart readiness, likely training level, biggest constraint, and likely support tier.
